task_summary: Implement a Flink job that reads Google cluster trace data, identifies job stages based on SUBMIT event sessions (10-min inactivity gap), and outputs the largest stage size per job.
decomposition_rationale: This task involves three distinct concerns: (1) understanding the existing project structure and AppBase pattern to correctly scaffold data types and integrate with the skeleton, (2) implementing the core Flink pipeline logic including CSV parsing, event-time session windows, and aggregation, and (3) handling file I/O (reading gzipped CSVs and writing output in the correct format). These are tightly coupled enough that 2 skills suffice: one for data model/schema setup and one for the complete Flink pipeline implementation.

skills.name: evo-cluster-data-model
skills.description: Provides guidance and utility patterns for defining Flink-compatible POJO data types (TaskEvent, JobEvent) based on the Google Cluster Trace 2011 v2 schema, including CSV parsing logic with proper field indexing and type handling for gzipped headerless CSVs.
skills.responsibility: Define the TaskEvent and JobEvent data type classes under clusterdata.datatypes, ensuring they meet Flink POJO serialization requirements (public fields, no-arg constructor). Provide CSV line parsing logic with correct column indices, handling of empty/missing fields, and microsecond timestamp semantics.
dr_sections: 1. Google Cluster Data 2011 v2 Schema Configuration

skills.name: evo-flink-session-window-pipeline
skills.description: Provides complete implementation guidance for the LongestSessionPerJob Flink job: reading gzipped CSV sources, assigning event-time watermarks with microsecond-to-millisecond conversion, filtering SUBMIT events, applying session windows with 10-minute gap, counting tasks per session via AggregateFunction, finding the max session per job via reduce, and writing output as (jobId,count) tuples to a local file using FileSink or writeAsText.
skills.responsibility: Implement the full Flink DataStream pipeline in LongestSessionPerJob.java: FileSource/readTextFile for gzipped input, WatermarkStrategy with bounded out-of-orderness and timestamp extraction, filter for event type 0 (SUBMIT), keyBy jobId, EventTimeSessionWindows with Duration.ofMinutes(10), aggregate+process window for counting, reduce for max session per job, and sink output in the required tuple format.
